name: Plant for the Planet Matching Grants
summary: One-year matching grants for nonprofits and local government programmes with a tree-planting record, funding urban, suburban or rural planting in forests, parks and along roadways in the LG&E, KU or ODP service territory.

geography.label: LG&E, KU or ODP service territory

access.quote: Grant applications will be accepted through our online grant portal.
